breakglass.lead: Use only when you must write without waiting for approval, e.g. during an incident.

breakglass.warning: While elevated, your writes run without approval (parse and policy denials and the affected-rows limit still apply). A reason and verification are required; it is recorded in the audit log and announced. Agents are never elevated.
